meta.title: Jadran Hills – seaside apartments in Privlaka near Zadar
meta.description: Three villas with 27 apartments, pools and private roof terraces in Privlaka – Sabunike near Zadar, Croatia, 30 metres from the beach. Final building permit, construction in preparation.
meta.ogTitle: Jadran Hills – between sea and mountains
meta.ogDescription: 27 apartments in three villas with pools and roof terraces. Privlaka – Sabunike, Zadar Riviera.
hero.sub: Three villas with 27 apartments, pools and private roof terraces. 30 metres from a sandy beach, with the Velebit range on the horizon.
hero.status: Final building permit · construction in preparation

intro.statement: Jadran Hills is taking shape in Sabunike, a quiet part of Privlaka near Zadar. Long sandy beaches with shallow water line the peninsula, and across the bay rises the wall of the Velebit mountains. The architecture is simple and open: large sliding doors, covered terraces and roofs that belong to the sun.
place.title1: A peninsula embraced by the sea.
place.lead: Privlaka lies on a narrow peninsula north of Zadar. It is a place of long beaches, pine trees and sunsets – and a good base for trips to the city and into the mountains.
place.sea.alt: A jetty and bathers in the shallow sea at Sabunike, with the Velebit mountains in the background
place.sea.credit: Sabunike beach · photo by Fred Romero, CC BY 2.0
place.sea.title: Sand and shallow sea
place.sea.text: Sabunike is known for its long sandy beach and shallow water that warms up quickly. It is a favourite with families with children and kitesurfers alike. The plot lies 30 metres from the beach.
place.mountains.alt: Rocky peaks of Velebit under a blue sky
place.mountains.title: Velebit, every day
place.mountains.text: The Velebit ridge can be seen from the coast all year round. Paklenica National Park, with its canyons and climbing walls, is about an hour’s drive away.
place.city.alt: The Zadar waterfront from above at sunset
place.city.title: Zadar within reach
place.city.text: The Roman Forum, the Sea Organ and the Greeting to the Sun are about 20 km away. Historic Nin with its salt pans is closer still.
dist.title: Distances
dist.note: Distances are approximate: to the beach from the plot boundary, elsewhere by road.
spot.title: Second row from the sea
spot.text: The plot lies 30 metres from a sandy beach, in the second row from the sea – one row of buildings and the seafront street stand in front of it. A private road leads to the villas. Sports grounds, a playground and a relaxation area are right next door.
spot.main.alt: Aerial view: the three Jadran Hills villas set into their surroundings, with the seafront street, the pier and the sea behind them
spot.main.caption: The three villas set into an aerial photograph. The beach and its pier lie just beyond the seafront street.
spot.sea.alt: Aerial photograph of the plot with the sea and the Velebit mountains behind it
spot.sea.caption: The plot today, with the sea and Velebit in the background.
spot.top.alt: Aerial photograph from above with the plot outlined in red
spot.top.caption: The plot from above, outlined in red.
project.title: Three villas. One signature.
project.lead: Each villa has three floors and nine apartments. Large sliding doors open the living rooms onto covered terraces, and the top floor belongs to private roof terraces.

project.artCaption: View from the garden. A drawing from the design documentation – three identical villas stand side by side.
feat.beach.title: 30 metres from the beach
feat.beach.text: The sandy beach with its pier and shallow sea lies just beyond the seafront street.
feat.pool.title: A pool for every villa
feat.pool.text: 7.4 × 2.7 m, with gentle salt-based water treatment and an outdoor shower.
feat.roof.title: Private roof terraces
feat.roof.text: 52 to 89 m² with a pergola, for the apartments on the top floor.
feat.terrace.title: A covered terrace for every apartment
feat.terrace.text: Around 12 m² behind a large sliding door – the living room continues outside.
feat.road.title: Private access road
feat.road.text: A road of their own leads straight from the street to the villas and parking spaces.
feat.air.title: Cooling and heating
feat.air.text: Air conditioning in every apartment, underfloor heating in the bathrooms.
feat.energy.title: Energy-efficient construction
feat.energy.text: Designed as a nearly zero-energy building.
feat.parking.title: Parking on site
feat.parking.text: Drive right up to the house – no searching for a space in high season.
feat.play.title: Playgrounds and relaxation area
feat.play.text: Right next to the plot: sports grounds, a playground and a place to relax.
apts.title: Two types. Three floors.
apts.lead: Each villa has six two-bedroom apartments and three one-bedroom apartments. Choose a floor.
apts.houseAlt: Diagram of a villa with three floors and a roof terrace
apts.p0.title: Ground floor – closest to the garden and the pool
apts.p0.text: From the living room you step through the sliding door straight onto the covered terrace and on into the garden.
apts.p1.title: 1st floor – more privacy, more air
apts.p1.text: The same layouts as on the ground floor, with a covered terrace at treetop height.
apts.p2.title: 2nd floor – with a private roof terrace
apts.p2.text: Each apartment has its own roof terrace with a pergola – a place for breakfast, dinner and the stars.
apts.twoRoofSpec: 60 m² + 12 m² terrace + loggia + 89 m² roof terrace
apts.oneRoofSpec: 37.5 m² + 12 m² terrace + 52 m² roof terrace
apts.note: Areas follow the design documentation. We confirm the availability of a specific apartment on request.
plans.title: Floor plans and prices
plans.lead: Both types have the same layout on all three floors. The apartments are handed over fitted out and prices include VAT.
plans.inc.title: Included in the price
plans.two.title: Two-bedroom apartment
plans.two.text: The living room with kitchen and dining area opens onto the covered terrace. Two bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate WC. There are two on every floor of a villa, mirrored at opposite ends.
plans.two.alt: Floor plan of the two-bedroom apartment: living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, bathroom, WC and covered terrace
plans.one.title: One-bedroom apartment
plans.one.text: Living room with kitchen and dining area, a bedroom and a bathroom. The covered terrace runs the full width of the apartment. In the middle of every floor.
plans.one.alt: Floor plan of the one-bedroom apartment: living room with kitchen, bedroom, bathroom and covered terrace
plans.note: List prices including VAT (25%). The floor plans come from the design documentation; the furnishings shown are illustrative.
rooms.living: Living room with kitchen, dining area and entrance

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.who.title: Who processes the data.
privacy.who.text: The developer of the Jadran Hills project.
privacy.who.form: Contact: via the form on this page.
privacy.what.title: What data and why.
privacy.what.text: Your name, email address, phone number and the text of the message you send us through the form. We use them only to reply to your enquiry and to send you materials about the project. The legal basis is your consent, which you may withdraw at any time.
privacy.how.title: How long and where.
privacy.how.text: For no longer than 24 months after our last contact. The data is stored in the European Union and we do not pass it on to third parties for marketing.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights.
privacy.rights.text: You may request access to your data, its correction or erasure, and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
privacy.cookies: This site uses no advertising or analytics cookies and loads no third-party content. Your browser only remembers the language you chose.
